journey.name: profile deletion progress
journey.description: Precondition: an onboarded disposable test wallet with Paykit enabled and a profile created through Bitkit. The profile and its contacts will be deleted; do not use a personal identity. Record the sequence so progress can be checked even when deletion completes quickly. During deletion, check the indicator on Delete Profile. Save stays disabled with its label visible.

actions.action: Open the existing profile from the Home header
Scroll to Delete Profile and tap it
Verify a progress indicator is visible while deletion is pending and profile actions cannot be used
Wait for deletion to finish and verify profile onboarding is shown
Return Home and reopen Profile; verify the deleted profile does not reappear
